introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.text: This page describes how this website manages cookies and user personal data, in compliance with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and the guidelines of the Italian Data Protection Authority.

technicalCookies.title: Technical Cookies
technicalCookies.text: This site uses technical cookies, which are necessary for the proper functioning of the website. These cookies do not require user consent as they are essential for providing the requested service.
technicalCookies.list1: Cookies for the functioning of interactive maps (Leaflet)

analyticsCookies.title: Analytics Cookies
analyticsCookies.text: This site uses Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to collect anonymous statistical information about website usage. These cookies are only installed with explicit user consent.
analyticsCookies.details: Google Analytics uses cookies to analyze how users interact with the site, collecting information such as:
analyticsCookies.list1: Number of visitors and pages visited

management.title: Cookie Management
management.text: On your first visit to the site, a banner is displayed that allows you to accept or reject non-essential cookies (analytics cookies).
management.details: Your preferences are saved in your browser and remembered for 6 months. You can change your preferences at any time by deleting cookies from your browser or by contacting us directly.

rights.title: User Rights
rights.text: Under GDPR, you have the right to:
rights.list2: Request correction or deletion of data
rights.list3: Object to data processing or withdraw consent at any time
